svg.title: N+1 Queries
svg.desc: N+1 Queries. One query for a list, then one more for every row: how ORMs fall into it, how to spot it, and how batching or a join fixes it. Step 1, 73 queries, one page: One page of 20 orders sends 73 queries: 1 for the orders, 20 for their items, 52 for products. Step 2, Lazy loading in a loop: order.items and item.product load on first access: 73 statements, only 3 distinct ones. Step 3, Batch by keys, or join: Batched with = ANY($1): 3 queries, 1.9 ms. One join with json_agg: 1 query, 1.2 ms. Step 4, Pitfalls: Pitfalls: preloading too much, endless IN lists, joins that multiply rows, caches, GraphQL.
